identity_cost.detail: card: an account is registered with an email address and a credit card is required for identity verification: 'You can create an account by registering your email address. For identity verification, a credit card is required when you create a new account.' A debit card is accepted when it is from Visa or Mastercard and is not a disposable card or one-time use card number, and authorization places 'a temporary hold on your credit card for verification and security when creating an account', reversed within 24 to 72 hours. Phone: not published: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/account?topic=account-accountfaqs (2026-11-06) states no phone requirement at registration. Country: not published: the same page states no country restriction.
